newsitem.title: USA: AGA says U.S. weekly natgas stocks rose 57 bcf.
newsitem.headline: AGA says U.S. weekly natgas stocks rose 57 bcf.

text.p: American Gas Association estimates of U.S. working gas in storage in billion cubic feet

Notes: (1) Incl Texas, Okla., Kansas, N.Mexico, Arkansas, Louisiana, and Miss. (2) Incl states east of Miss. River less Miss., plus Iowa, Neb and Missouri (3) Incl states west of the Miss. River less producing region and Iowa, Neb and Missouri.
Survey sample and full working gas estimates - Survey Sample Est. Full Work- Yr-Ago

Notes: (4) Ratio of max WG vol. to est. of highest WG in storage in past 2 yrs (EIA).(5) Highest WG level by state added to give regional and national levels (EIA).(6) Regional and total vols divided by est.full regional and total vols.

*AGA said the company with underground storage operations in both the Producing and Consuming East regions that had temporarily withdrawn from the American Gas Storage Survey has returned. Therefore the reporting sample size in the survey for the October 18 week is consistent with the participation level in the survey for the September 27 week and prior surveys. The net changes reported in the transition weeks in the Producing Region have been affected by the change in sample size, AGA said.
